title.narrative: START Cholera response in Harare and Chimanimani

description.narrative: Project Overall Objective: The project will minimize the risk of further spreading Cholera in Dzivarasekwa and ChimanimaniOutcome: Realization of positive behavior change and prevention of water-borne diseases in Dzivarasekwa and Chimanimani.Impact: Reduced morbidity and mortality due to water and sanitation related diseases

The project aims to address the poor hygiene standards through hygiene education in affected communities addressing those affected and those at risk of contracting the diseases. The door to door strategy through the village health workers/volunteers/hygiene promoters will be key so that at 80% of the the targeted households can be visited. The project also aims to distribute hygiene enabling NFI kits comprising of buckets for treatment of water at point of use with a tap for controlled water dispensing. And jerrycans to to collect and store water. Water treatment chemicals will be provided for 3 months. 2 bars of soap for handwashing at critical times . To improve safe water availability, borehole rehabilitation will be done in the two districts
